summary.text: K.C. Tomlinson is a Republican state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 18 since April 6, 2020 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: K.C. Tomlinson assumed office in the state House in April 2020.

In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure, Gaming Oversight and Professional Licensure committees, serving as a subcommittee chair on consumer protection and as secretary of Gaming Oversight.
